text:
maria: FYI I'm starting a lightweight docs PR to add localized examples for audit exports. Goal: Spanish and Japanese snippets + short i18n keys for SOC2-friendly wording.
jake: sounds good. Avoid legal-sounding certs in copy. Keep it plain: 'audit evidence' -> use i18n key audit.export.evidence_label and reference policy page for retention.
li: question: do we inline localized code comments (\"Ejemplo\") or have a language switcher? Prefer inline small note above snippet.
sam: inline note is fine. keep the code itself identical across locales to avoid diverging command examples.
maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4621 (title: "localize: audit export examples (es, ja) + i18n keys").
li: draft Spanish snippet below, will push to PR branch:

maria: please ensure dates are abstracted. don't hardcode customer IDs in examples. use placeholders like t-<tenant_id> and YYYY-MM-DD.

li: updated snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"t-<tenant_id>","since":"YYYY-MM-DD","format":"jsonl"}'
```

li: and python:

```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = c.audit.export(tenant_id="t-<tenant_id>", since="YYYY-MM-DD", format="jsonl")
```

oliver: quick review note: phrase "audit evidence" in English i18n should be neutral. legal prefers "audit export records" in some locales; we'll need their input per-locale.

legal-bot: Automated reminder: translations that reference SOC2 or regulatory terms must be validated by Legal before release. Submit translation PR comment with source strings.

jake: retention phrasing checklist: use generic TTL example only. e.g. "We retain audit export records up to 90 days unless placed on legal hold." Link to /security/retention-policy. Do not suggest automatic deletion triggers in examples.

maria: Action list: (1) legal to provide validated translations for three keys: audit.export.evidence_label, audit.export.instruction_note, audit.export.retention_clause; (2) li to commit localized snippet blocks and annotated comments; (3) docs to run linkcheck and i18n lint; (4) legal-bot to confirm translations.

li: ETA: pushing branch updates in 2 hours. I'll include comments above code blocks: "Ejemplo" and "例".

oliver: I'll schedule a quick docs review tomorrow AM. priority: ensure retention link points to canonical policy page and that examples don't imply particular retention for customers.

doc-bot: docs CI queued for PR #4621. staging build will publish under /i18n/es/audit-export if successful.

maria: note: when we merge, add a short release note: "localized audit export examples (es, ja) — translations pending legal approval". That way site won't imply final legal sign off.

legal-bot: Translation request logged: https://legal.redwood/tasks/8793. Attach PR link and strings file.

jake: one more: keep sample outputs redacted; don't show real tokens, keys, or PII in examples. Use placeholder values and explicitly annotate them.

maria: thanks all. I'll update PR checklist and tag legal and translations.
